variables.name: light
variables.description: Oil-lamp reserve. Decreases by 1 at each of three lit-shortcut checkpoints (a culvert, a failing stope, a slab-choked drift). Reachable set at the tower is {0,1,2,3}; read only in ending prose flavor, not gated by condition (the transmitter/trust gates carry the finale).

variables.name: trust
variables.description: Dell Voss's confidence in you, built at three checkpoints where you look out for Dell over yourself (a failing rail, a catwalk gap, a switchback). Reachable set at the tower is {0,1,2}. Gates the finale's second resolution: trust==2 opens the together ending, ==1 a creditable solo ending, ==0 the estranged ending, on both the fixed and flare branches.

variables.name: transmitter
variables.description: Whether you recovered the tower's spare valve, wedged behind a rockfall at exactly one node partway down. Both values are reachable at the tower. Gates the finale's first resolution: true opens the clean-call branch, false forces the improvised flare branch.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=64 beats='the last bus back stopped running an hour ago and the storm the forecast promised for midnight is already stacking over the ridge when Dell Voss's torch finds you at the quarry gate, the Meridian survey crew three days overdue and the old signal tower the only working line down there left'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='Dell lays a hand on the padlock and does not open it yet: three ways go down into the working, the terraced spoil road, the flooded cut, and the old crane road, and whichever one you take tonight is the one you keep'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=72 beats='the spoil terraces step down in loose grey shale, easy underfoot but loud, every stride announcing you to anything listening in the dark below'>>

choices.label: Go carefully and save the lamp.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=72 beats='the flooded cut is the quarry's old drainage channel, black water to the knee and colder than it has any right to be this early in the season'>>

choices.label: Go carefully and save the lamp.
Go carefully and save the lamp.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=72 beats='the crane road is the derelict haul route the loading rigs used, iron rails half-buried and a gantry crane rusted mid-swing overhead'>>

choices.label: Go carefully and save the lamp.

<<FILL role=rising words=72 beats='you thread the terrace slowly, choosing each foothold, and the extra minutes cost nothing but the dark closing in behind you'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=72 beats='you wade the cut at a hard pace, current tugging at your knees, trusting the lamp to find the next dry step before your foot does'>>

choices.label: Start the climb to the tower.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=43 beats='the tower stair spirals up the outside of the old winding house, rusted through in places, a service hatch hanging open at the top'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=65 beats='the transmitter room is exactly as the crew left it, a spare valve missing from the set since the day it failed, and whether you are holding that valve right now decides everything about what happens next'>>

choices.label: Fit the valve you carried down.
Rig a flare from the lamp instead.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=72 beats='the valve seats clean on the first try and the set hums back to life under your hands, the old relay light blinking awake for the first time in three days'>>

<<FILL role=rising words=72 beats='with no valve to fit, you strip the lamp for its oil and rig a flare off the tower rail instead, the last of the light spent on one single throw against the coming storm'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=76 beats='the set is live and the call will go through clean, but what comes back over it, and whether Dell is still beside you to hear it, depends on the whole night behind you now'>>

choices.label: Trust carried you both this far.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=76 beats='the flare is one shot into a sky already lit by the storm, and whether anyone is watching for it, and whether Dell still trusts your aim, depends on the whole night behind you now'>>

nodes.body: <<FILL role=success words=80 beats='the call goes through and so does everything you did to earn it; Dell keys the second channel without being asked and between you the whole crew's position goes out clean, rescue moving before the storm breaks'>>

<<FILL role=completion words=78 beats='the call goes through and rescue is coming; Dell stands a little apart at the rail while you make it, glad of the result and still weighing the night it took to get here'>>

<<FILL role=completion words=78 beats='the call goes through, and it is the only thing that does; Dell went back for the gate two hours ago and you send the crew's position out to an empty tower with nobody beside you to hear it land'>>

<<FILL role=success words=78 beats='Dell has the timing of the storm in a way you never could, and calls the exact second to loose the flare; it clears the ridge and someone, somewhere below, is already watching for it'>>

<<FILL role=discovery words=76 beats='the flare clears the ridge and burns for its ten seconds against the cloud; whether it was seen is a question the night does not answer either way before you have to climb back down'>>

<<FILL role=setback words=76 beats='the flare goes up alone, badly timed against a gust that was never going to give you a clean throw, and it is gone into the storm with nothing behind it and no one left to have watched for it'>>
